purpose: One picture from a picture-making service, recorded before and after the call.
namedChanges: makePicture takes a host (reserve, writeAttempt, store, finish) instead of Social's month counter and vault client; the attempt's facts are the host's.
The picture egress is self-contained: https, the base origin or a listed output host, no IP address, no machine name, no port but 443; the app's own rules come in through extraGuard.
The client sends output_format when asked.

host.replaces: Social's month counter reserve (workers/social-worker/src/pictures/monthCount.ts) inside makePicture
Social's vault.create of t:PictureMakingAttempt with attemptFacts inside makePicture
Social's vault.putFile with three tries inside makePicture
Social's vault.patch with attemptOutcomeFacts inside makePicture
the Worker variables and secret read by pictureConfig
